answer: Proof of unique festival volunteer record with festival organiser attestation turns identity into something scarce. Because shifts the organiser recorded across years of festivals, the mirror of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the signal is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the quartz is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
